name: Badya in October Gardens
location: Badya by Palm Hills is located in the heart of 6th of October City, on El Wahat (Oasis) Road, near Creative City and Faiyum Desert Road. It connects East and West Cairo, offering strategic access from several main roads.
description: Badya Palm Hills covers about 3000 acres and is a landmark integrated project by Palm Hills offering apartments, villas, twin houses, and penthouses. It is designed as a sustainable smart city with green spaces, modern amenities, educational and healthcare facilities.
landmarks: About 15 minutes from Giza Pyramid Complex
Approximately 30 kilometers from the New Capital
10 minutes from major services in October City

name: Scenes in Mostakbal City
location: Scenes by Tatweer Misr is situated in a prime location in Mostakbal City, with easy access to major roads including the Ring Road and Suez Road. It is close to Future University and the American University, also near Madinaty, Al Rehab, and The Butterflies Compound.
description: Scenes Mostakbal City by Tatweer Misr is a luxurious residential compound covering approximately 100 feddan, offering villas, twin houses, and townhouses with high-end finishes. It features expansive green areas, lakes, and modern amenities, delivering upscale integrated living.

name: Solana in New Zayed
location: Solana by Ora Developers is located in New Zayed, between Al Dabaa Corridor and Middle Ring Road, directly on the Dabaa axis, near Cairo-Alexandria Desert Road and Waslet Dahshour Road.
description: Solana New Zayed is a premium compound developed by Ora, built on ~316 acres. It offers high-end residential units with modern architecture, lush green spaces, water bodies, world-class amenities including commercial areas, sports facilities, parks, medical services, and security.

name: ZED in El Sheikh Zayed
location: ZED El Sheikh Zayed by Ora Developers is located in the heart of El Sheikh Zayed City in Western Cairo, with excellent visibility from Al Nozha Road, and proximity to the 26th of July Corridor and Alexandria Desert Road.
description: ZED El Sheikh Zayed is built on approximately 165 acres, surrounding the one-of-a-kind ZED Park. It offers generous green spaces, mixed-use retail and entertainment facilities, sports complexes, picturesque water features, interconnected landscaped courtyards and contemporary residential units.
landmarks: Major Retail & Entertainment Areas in Sheikh Zayed
Proximity to main educational and health facilities

name: PX in 6th of October City
location: PX Palm Hills is situated in the Eastern Extension of 6th of October City, on the Palm Hills plateau, overlooking New Giza and between New Giza Compound and The Crown. It has easy access from 26th of July Corridor, Wahat Road, Waslet Dahshour Road, and Mall of Egypt Road.
description: PX by Palm Hills spans approximately 370 acres and is designed as a luxury, integrated residential compound featuring apartments, villas, townhouses, and penthouses. The project emphasizes green spaces, water features, commercial hubs, and luxurious amenities blending nature with modern living.

name: Cleo – Palm Hills
location: Cleo Water Residences is a phase inside Palm Hills New Cairo, located in the 5th Settlement. It enjoys strategic proximity to Cairo International Airport (about 10 minutes), the American University in Cairo (about 15 minutes), the New Administrative Capital, Suez Road, Rehab City, and major highways.
description: Cleo Palm Hills (Cleo Water Residences) is part of Palm Hills New Cairo, offering apartments and studios (1-3 bedrooms) in fully finished buildings, with vast greenery (≈80-82%) and lagoons, vibrant landscape design, and amenities such as gyms, outdoor spaces, lagoons, lakes, and recreational areas.
landmarks: Major highways and roads around New Cairo

name: Scene 7
location: Scene 7 New Capital Compound is located in the Residential District R7, Plot G2 in the New Administrative Capital, along extension of the 90th Street. It overlooks four main streets and is close to Diplomatic District, Medical City, Government Complex, Green River, New Capital Airport, and major services.
description: Scene 7 is developed by Akam Developments on about 40 acres. It features large green areas, artificial lakes, sports academies, modern clubhouse, luxury services, entertainment and commercial hubs. It is designed to combine upscale living with leisure and nature. Units vary in size, designs, and amenities.

name: 31 West in 6th of October
location: 31 West by M Squared is located in the eastern extension of 6th of October City, directly off the 26th of July Corridor, adjacent to Palm Hills Bamboo Extension. It enjoys proximity to Mall of Egypt, Mall of Arabia, Sphinx International Airport, and surrounding upscale communities such as New Giza and October Gardens.
description: 31 West is a residential compound on ~31 acres featuring apartments, townhouses, twin houses, and standalone villas. The design emphasizes open space, lakes, landscaped gardens, and a balance between architecture and natural elements. Amenities include commercial hubs, leisure & sports facilities, kids’ areas, green walking/cycling paths, and high security.

name: Scenario in New Capital
location: Scenario New Capital by Akam Developments is located in R7, plot A2, in the heart of the New Administrative Capital. It is near IL Bosco compound, Midtown Sky, the Embassy and Diplomatic Districts, the Presidential Palace, Al Masa Hotel, the Green River, British University, Mohammed Bin Zayed axis.
description: Scenario New Capital is a high-end residential compound by Akam Developments spread over about 39-40 acres. It offers apartments, duplexes, and possibly hotel apartments with large green areas, artificial lakes, modern architectural designs, and full amenities aiming for comfort, luxury and privacy.

name: The Wonder Marq
location: The Wonder Marq by The Marq Communities is located in Mostakbal City, East Cairo. It has strategic access via the Suez Road and Road 90, near New Cairo, MV Square, and Downtown Mall.
description: The Wonder Marq is a high-end integrated residential community comprising residential clusters overlooking water features, gardens, and lush landscaping. It includes amenities like schools, medical complexes, commercial areas, lakes, swimmable lagoons, and entertainment zones. Designed for luxury and lifestyle, it offers various unit types including villas, townhouses, and standalone homes.
landmarks: Other major compounds in Mostakbal City

name: Bleu Vert
location: Bleu Vert is located in the New Administrative Capital on the Mohammed Bin Zayed axis (R7 district), close to the Cathedral Church, Al Masa Hotel, the Bin Zayed Axis, and near key roads and government districts.
description: Bleu Vert by Saudi Egyptian Developers (SED) is a 70-acre integrated residential compound with ~1,792 units, 54 apartment buildings, plus townhouses and twin villas. Features include large landscaped gardens, club house, spa, gym, commercial hub, and high-end amenities.

name: Bluetree
location: Bluetree by Sky AD is in the Golden Square area of the 5th Settlement, New Cairo, next to Al Ahly Club, accessible via Mohamed Bin Zayed and Abbas Al Akkad axes. It is around 15 min from AUC and close to key services in New Cairo.
description: Bluetree New Cairo is a boutique compound built on ~50 acres, with ~1,300 units including apartments and duplexes. The project emphasizes green spaces (≈81%), water features, central park, jogging & cycling lanes, clubhouse, and modern amenities.

name: D-Bay in Al Dabaa
location: Tatweer Misr developed the D Bay North Coast Project in a prime location overlooking the Mediterranean Sea, specifically in Al Dabaa. The resort is smartly situated on 165th km of the International Coastal Road and in proximity to other roads as well .
description: D Bay North Coast Resort was developed by Tatweer Misr over 200 acres. It is a luxurious coastal project that was built to reshape vacationers’ summer experiences, blending various shades of blues and greens in a state-of-the-art beach haven. Aesthetics and culture merge in DBay El Sahel, making it one of the best vacation destinations in the North Coast.
